mapper.select: SELECT create_time, accessType AS action, feed_source AS feed_source FROM aro_access_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE aro_personnel p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT name, COUNT(*) * 10 AS total_exp FROM aro_access_log WHERE accessType = 1 GROUP BY name ) l ON l.name = p.name SET p.total_exp = COALESCE(l.total_exp, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM twin_automation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND automation_type = 'AUTO_SIGNOUT' AND trigger_type = 'STRANDED_VIOLATION' AND success = 1 AND DATE(event_time) = CURDATE() LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(create_time, 1, 10) AS log_date FROM aro_access_log ORDER BY log_date ASC
